Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Basics Pendant Lamp - 15.7" x 15.7" x 60", Matte Black
Colors: Matte Black
Materials: Metal
Fabric shade: gracefully diffuses light and offers a round shape for a visually pleasing profile Metal base: sturdy metal base offers long-lasting strength and a sleek appearance Modern style: coordinates effortlessly with surrounding contemporary or transitional decor Small size: relatively small size makes it a great choice for a bedroom, kitchen, living room, or office Simple set-up and warranty: designed to hang from the ceiling; assembles quickly and easily (screwdriver and light bulb needed, not included); backed by an Amazon Basics 1-year limited warranty
